title: SB86 (2023 Regular): Rifles and Shotguns – Possession – Age Requirement (Raise the Age Act of 2023)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2023RS/bills/sb/sb0086f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed), no date in text. No passage vote recorded. Quotes drop the words the bill deletes from existing law (bracketed in the text: "solely designed for a regulated"; "transfer, or"; "transferee, or recipient"). The bill also deletes the old ban on selling a non-regulated firearm or ammunition to any minor in § 5-134(d)(1)(ii), replacing it with the age-21 ammunition rule, and sets the general § 5-205 penalty "EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN SUBSECTION (C)". Quote of § 5-205(c) joins text across a page break.
